case_matrix.case: Unrelated registered bootstrap runtime, same or different thread, any registry order
case_matrix.proof: Its sealed descriptor differs; no runtime getter, repository or clock source is read for it.

case_matrix.case: Genuine unique adopted matching owner on original thread
case_matrix.proof: All exact registry/startup/source/app checks precede selected live original digest and existing private binding.

case_matrix.case: Zero matching registrations or copied/forged serialized original
case_matrix.proof: No match rejects; descriptor match alone still cannot bypass registry/type/startup/thread/app/durable original checks.
Count check rejects before either live getter; no first-match or exception-based fallback.

case_matrix.case: Matching target is closed, expired, revoked, foreign-thread, source/session drifted or pre-adoption
case_matrix.proof: Strict selected checks and owner._check_app_live reject, or selected original getter reports unavailable; no fallback/swallowing.
Existing _local_bind_grounding and two-authority locked checks remain unchanged; no snapshot promoted to authority.
